title: A1C test
content:
# A1C test
## What it measures
The A1C test measures your average blood sugar level over the past three months.
## Results
An A1C between 5.7 and 6.4 percent means prediabetes. An A1C of 6.5 percent or higher on two separate tests means diabetes.

title: Acetaminophen
content:
# Acetaminophen
## Why is this medication prescribed?
Acetaminophen is used to relieve mild to moderate pain and to reduce fever.
## How should this medicine be used?
Adults should not take more than 4000 mg of acetaminophen in 24 hours.
## Overdose
An overdose can seriously damage the liver. Call emergency services immediately.
